items.item_name: Pio Cinnamon Honey From Sri Lanka
items.description: Pio Cinnamon Honey from Sri Lanka typically refers to honey infused with Ceylon cinnamon, also known as true cinnamon, which is native to Sri Lanka. Ceylon cinnamon is prized for its delicate, sweet flavor and lower coumarin content compared to Cassia cinnamon. Pio Cinnamon Honey combines the natural sweetness of honey with the unique, aromatic qualities of Ceylon cinnamon.

Start your day right with our classic egg omelet, a versatile and delicious dish perfect for breakfast, brunch or any time you crave something quick and satisfying. Our omelet is made with farm-fresh eggs, beaten to perfection and cooked until fluffy and golden. It is seasoned with a hint of salt and pepper and filled with fresh vegetables, cheese and herbs.
Each bite of our egg omelet offers a delightful combination of textures and flavors, with the creamy eggs complementing the savory fillings. It's a wholesome and nutritious option that can be customized to suit your taste preferences.

Savor the rich and hearty flavors of Qeema, a classic minced meat curry that embodies the essence of traditional cuisine. This flavorful dish features finely minced meat, slow-cooked with a blend of aromatic spices, tomatoes, and onions, resulting in a mouthwatering and satisfying meal.

Our Qeema is prepared with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that every bite is infused with the perfect balance of spices and herbs. The minced meat is tender and juicy, absorbing the robust flavors of the curry, making it an ideal choice for any occasion.

Enjoy the simplicity and deliciousness of our egg half fry, a perfect addition to any meal. This classic dish features a farm-fresh egg, fried to perfection with a crispy edge and a soft, runny yolk at the center. Lightly seasoned with a touch of salt and pepper, our egg half fry is both flavorful and satisfying.
Ideal for breakfast, brunch, or even as a quick snack, the egg half fry is versatile and can be paired with a variety of dishes. Whether you enjoy it with toast, paratha, or as a topping on your favorite salad or bowl, it adds a delightful burst of protein and flavor.

Delight in the exotic flavors of maghaz brain masala, a luxurious and richly spiced dish that is a true testament to culinary tradition. this delicacy features tender and creamy lamb brain, skillfully cooked with a harmonious blend of aromatic spices, onions, tomatoes, and fresh herbs, creating a sumptuous and unforgettable experience.
our maghaz is a perfect balance of flavor and texture, with the delicate brain absorbing the robust spices, resulting in a dish that is both indulgent and satisfying. each bite promises a melt-in-your-mouth sensation, enhanced by the warming spices and fragrant herbs.

Experience the rich and soothing flavors of karak tea, a beloved traditional beverage that offers warmth and comfort in every sip. this aromatic tea is prepared by brewing strong black tea with a blend of spices, including cardamom and cinnamon, and simmering it with creamy milk to create a perfectly balanced and flavorful drink. our karak tea is carefully crafted to achieve the ideal blend of sweetness, spice, and creaminess, making it a perfect companion for any time of the day. whether you enjoy it with breakfast, as an afternoon pick-me-up, or as a relaxing evening treat, karak tea is sure to delight your senses.
